No request input adapters or network-facing application boundary in package source. Test pickle operations are round-trips of local objects. CI reviewed as configuration only; no security-positive CI exploit claims.

limitations: All tracked Python sources, tests, and Python/docs/CI configuration read statically. This is full-file review coverage, not exhaustive semantic ground truth.

Public API compatibility and callback argument contracts are preserved; unused parameters are not removal positives.
No confirmed exploitable security positives were found. Security recall is unmeasured.
